import html from typing import List # Predefined template – replace placeholders with safe content USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

{content}
{labels}
""" def _escape(value: str) -> str: """Return an HTML‑escaped version of *value*.""" return html.escape(value, quote=True) def render_blog_post( author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: List[str] ) -> str: """ Render a forum post as safe HTML. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the post's creator. post_heading : str The heading/title of the user's post. content : str The main body text of the post. labels : list[str] Labels/tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML representation of the post. """ # Validate and escape all inputs safe_author = _escape(author_id or "") safe_heading = _escape(post_heading or "") safe_content = _escape(content or "") # Wrap each label in a and escape it safe_labels = " ".join( f'{_escape(label)}' for label in labels or [] ) # Use the template, substituting escaped values return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=safe_labels )
